### 1. Individual Income Tax Return Due Dates and Extensions

* **Calendar-Year Return Due Date:** April 15 (applies to tax years 2025 and 2026; if it falls on a weekend or holiday, the due date is the next business day).
* **Extension Rules:** 
  * Montana grants an automatic 6-month extension to file individual income tax returns. 
  * The extended due date for calendar-year filers is October 15.
  * An extension to file is not an extension to pay; any tax owed must be paid by the original April 15 deadline to avoid penalties and interest.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Montana Department of Revenue: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/individual-income-tax/
  * Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-2604: https://leg.mt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0260/section_0040/0150-0300-0260-0040.html

---

### 2. Corporate and Pass-Through Entity Due Dates and Extension Rules

#### Corporate Income Tax (Form CIT)
* **Return Due Date:** 
  * Calendar-year filers: May 15. 
  * Fiscal-year filers: 15th day of the 5th month following the close of the tax year.
* **Extension Rules:** 
  * Montana grants an automatic 6-month extension of time to file. 
  * Calendar-year extended due date: November 15. 
  * Fiscal-year extended due date: 15th day of the 11th month after the close of the fiscal year.
  * An extension to file does not extend the time to pay tax liabilities.
* **Official URL:** 
  * Montana Department of Revenue: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/corporate-income-tax/

#### Pass-Through Entities (Form PTE)
* **Return Due Date:** 
  * Calendar-year filers: March 15. 
  * Fiscal-year filers: 15th day of the 3rd month following the close of the tax year.
* **Extension Rules:** 
  * Automatic 6-month extension.
  * Calendar-year extended due date: September 15.
* **Official URL:** 
  * Montana Department of Revenue: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/pass-through-entities/

---

### 3. Elective Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET)

* **Existence:** Yes. Enacted under Senate Bill 554 (effective beginning tax year 2023) and codified at Mont. Code Ann. §§ 15-30-3325 through 15-30-3328.
* **Tax Rate:** 
  * 5.9% of each electing/affected owner’s distributive share of Montana-source income for tax years 2025 and 2026 (the rate matches the highest marginal individual income tax rate in effect under MCA § 15-30-2103).
* **How and When to Elect:** 
  * The election is made annually by an eligible pass-through entity (partnership or S corporation) directly on a timely-filed Form PTE (including extensions, by September 15 for calendar-year filers).
  * Once made for the tax year, the election is irrevocable. Elections submitted after the extended due date are invalid.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Montana Department of Revenue: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/pass-through-entities/
  * Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-3326: https://leg.mt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0330/section_0260/0150-0300-0330-0260.html

---

### 4. Composite Returns for Pass-Through Entities

* **Existence and Mechanism:** 
  * Yes, pass-through entities may file a composite return on behalf of consenting eligible nonresident owners directly using Form PTE and its schedules (separate standalone composite forms CLT-4S and PR-1 have been discontinued).
* **Composite Tax Rate:** 
  * The composite tax is calculated at the highest individual marginal tax rate (5.9% for tax years 2025 and 2026 under MCA § 15-30-2103).
* **Filing Date:** Same as Form PTE (March 15; September 15 on extension).
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-3312: https://leg.mt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0330/section_0120/0150-0300-0330-0120.html
  * Montana Department of Revenue: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/pass-through-entities/

---

### 5. Estimated Tax Payments and Nonresident Withholding for Pass-Throughs

* **Nonresident Withholding Requirement:** 
  * Under Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-3313, if a pass-through entity has a nonresident individual, foreign C corporation, or upper-tier entity owner whose distributive share of Montana source income is $1,000 or more, the pass-through entity must do one of the following on or before the due date (including extensions):
    1. Include the owner in a composite return;
    2. File an executed owner tax agreement (Form PT-AGR) in which the owner agrees to timely file Montana returns and pay tax; or
    3. Remit withholding on behalf of the nonresident owner at the highest marginal rate (5.9% for 2025 and 2026).
* **Pass-Through Entity Estimated Taxes:** 
  * Entities that owe composite tax or elective pass-through entity tax (PTET) are subject to estimated tax payment requirements and underpayment interest.
  * Form EST-PTI is used to report and calculate interest on underpayment of estimated pass-through and composite tax.
* **Corporate Estimated Tax Requirements:** 
  * Corporations that anticipate a tax liability of $5,000 or more must make quarterly estimated payments due on the 15th day of the 4th, 6th, 9th, and 12th months of the tax year.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * Mont. Code Ann. § 15-30-3313: https://leg.mt.gov/bills/mca/title_0150/chapter_0300/part_0330/section_0130/0150-0300-0330-0130.html
  * Montana Department of Revenue Pass-Through Entities: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/pass-through-entities/
  * Montana Department of Revenue Corporate Income Tax: https://mtrevenue.gov/taxes/business-taxes/corporate-income-tax/

---

### 6. Main Return and Compliance Forms

* **Individual Income Tax:**
  * **Form 2:** Montana Individual Income Tax Return
  * **Form IT:** Montana Individual Income Tax Payment Voucher
  * **Form EST-I:** Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Individuals, Estates, and Trusts
* **Corporate Income Tax:**
  * **Form CIT:** Montana Corporate Income Tax Return
  * **Form CIT Voucher:** Montana Corporate Income Tax Payment Voucher
  * **Form CIT-UT:** Underpayment of Estimated Tax by Corporation
* **Pass-Through Entities:**
  * **Form PTE:** Montana Pass-Through Entity Tax Return (used for partnerships, S corporations, PTET election, and composite tax)
  * **Form PTE, Schedule K-1:** Montana Owner's Share of Income, Deductions, and Credits
  * **Form PR:** Montana Partnership Tax Payment Voucher
  * **Form SB:** Montana Small Business Corporation (S Corp) Tax Payment Voucher
  * **Form PT-AGR:** Pass-Through Entity Owner Tax Agreement
  * **Form EST-PTI:** Interest on Underpayment of Estimated Tax for Composite Tax and Pass-Through Entity Tax
* **Official URL:** 
  * Montana Department of Revenue Forms Repository: https://mtrevenue.gov/forms/
